text: Jay, a former British soldier turned hitman, is broke and still shaken by a disastrous job in Kyiv when he [takes the work his friend Gal offers|trigger|saying yes to an offer]. The client [seals the contract in blood|rules|everything has a price] and hands them a list of three names: the Priest, the Librarian and the MP. The first two targets thank Jay before they die, and [his violence spills far past the job|threat|the enemy within], until in the woods outside the MP's mansion they witness [a masked ceremony ending in human sacrifice|wants|the sacrifice demanded].
